summary: Schema 018 is current. RC217 keeps email-only login with separate display names, replaces native browser confirmations with accessible dialogs, fixes theme keyboard activation, and accepts valid OCI descriptor artifactType metadata during managed-registry inventory and cleanup. It also carries Helm capability mapping, Git bundle CAS, immutable source replacement, Kubernetes 1.36 builder policy fixes, registry pull rotation, and recoverable Argo retries.
